arabic text: Bekasi hai gham hi gham hai fatema zahra ke baad\nZindagi ki aankh nam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: There is helplessness and grief upon grief after Fatima Zahra;\nthe eyes of life remain wet after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Ro raha hai dil ko thaame shere yazdaan sa jari\nTham gaya seene mei dam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: The Lion of God weeps, clutching his heart;\nhis breath has stopped within his chest after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Shabbar o shabbir ki dadhkan bhi zakhmi hogayin\nSaans shamsheer e sitam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: The heartbeats of Shabbar and Shabbir were wounded;\nevery breath became a sword of oppression after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Zainab o kulsoom ne phir to sahar dekhi nahin\nZindagi sham e alam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: Zainab and Kulsum never again saw a true dawn;\nlife became an evening of sorrow after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Arsh waale farsh wale sab hi matamdaar hain\nNoha khwaani har qadam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: Those upon the Throne and those upon the earth are all mourners;\nlaments are recited at every step after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Keh gayeen fizza se zahra rakhna bachon ka khayal\nTum ko zahra ki qasam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: Zahra told Fizza: take care of my children;\nI place you under Zahra's oath after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Arshe oola arze sidra gumbade khizra malool\nRoyi deewar e haram hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: The highest Throne, the land of Sidra and the green dome became sorrowful;\neven the walls of the sanctuary wept after Fatima Zahra.

arabic text: Zindagi ahle aza ki mehwe matam hogayi\nKya wujood aur kya adam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: The lives of the mourners became absorbed in matam;\nwhat meaning remained in existence or non-existence after Fatima Zahra?

arabic text: Aaj tak 'Salman' har qirtaas hai farshe aza\nNoha khwan ab tak qalam hai fatema zahra ke baad
english translation text: O "Salman", until today every page remains a mourning floor;\nthe pen continues to recite laments after Fatima Zahra.
